thread:
Maya (CS): Morning — Helix day0 private/VPC onboarding. Quick list: egress allowlist, runtime service account for model pulls, KMS ACL + rotation plan, audit log ingestion to customer Splunk with integrity header. @Arjun can you own SA/IAM and firewall followup? :wave:
Arjun (Eng-Infra): Yep. What SA name will Helix create and where are models stored?
Nadia (Helix): Creating `helix-runtime-sa` in project `helix-prod`. Models in GCS `gs://helix-models-prod`. We also mirror a small subset to S3 for backups.
Arjun (Eng-Infra): Plan: grant `roles/storage.objectViewer` and `roles/iam.serviceAccountUser` once SA exists. Which egress ranges should we request?
Maya (CS): Standard ranges: `35.196.0.0/14` and `34.120.0.0/14`. Ports: 443 and 10250 for healthchecks; metrics may use 15002 depending on agent.
Priya (Security): KMS requirements: quarterly rotation. Key resource please. KMS policy needs `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` for `serviceAccount:redwood-runtime@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com` and `roles/cloudkms.viewer` for `group:helix-security@helix.example.com`. Also require audit retention 365 days and HMAC integrity header `X-Event-Signature`.
Nadia (Helix): Key: `projects/helix-prod/locations/global/keyRings/helix-kr/cryptoKeys/helix-main`. We'll post a minimal policy snippet to the secure handoff doc.
runbook-bot: Runbook created: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/helix-week0 — includes onboarding checklist and KMS rotation template.
Leo (SRE): For Splunk ingestion: mTLS (client cert) required, TLS1.2+, and HMAC-SHA256 signature on `X-Event-Signature`. Endpoint? Also please DM a 3-line sample JSON event so we can validate parsing.
Nadia (Helix): Splunk endpoint: `https://splunk.helix.example/services/collector`. Sample event (will DM to #support-telemetry): {"ts":"2026-03-20T11:22:33Z","svc":"helix-agent","evt":{"type":"model.pull","model":"hx-7b","status":"ok","size":54321}}
Arjun (Eng-Infra): I'll apply IAM once SA exists and confirm here. Leo — we'll upload CSR or certs to the runbook secure attachment.
Priya (Security): I'll review the key policy once Nadia posts the snippet. Reminder: do not paste secrets here. Use secure handoff doc for certs/HMAC secret.
Maya (CS): Action summary: 1) Nadia create SA + upload certs + paste policy snippet to secure doc; 2) Arjun apply IAM and whitelist egress; 3) Priya sign off KMS policy & rotation; 4) Leo validate Splunk ingestion and HMAC header. Target: EOD tomorrow PST. Any blockers? :thumbsup:
Nadia (Helix): :thumbsup: Aiming to provision SA and upload artifacts by EOD PST. We'll DM the sample payload and CSR to secure handoff.
Maya (CS): Great — I'll update the runbook owners/ETAs and follow up tomorrow morning. —Maya
